nam-conv.title: Level 1-1: Naming Conventions
nam-conv.desc: Master the chaos. A standardized strategy to organize Assets, Data Extensions, and automations across multiple Business Units.
best: Use a hierarchical structure by asset type.
Assign permissions by folder, avoid global admin.
mistakes: Inconsistent names like 'Campaign_Final_v2_TEST'.
Lack of a zArchive folder for obsolete items.

sql-sarg.title: Level 1-2: SARGable SQL
sql-sarg.desc: Beat the 30-minute timeout. Write scalable and 'SARGable' SQL queries for Data Extensions.
best: Avoid initial wildcards in LIKE.
Deduplicate with ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY...).
mistakes: Using SELECT * instead of explicit fields.
Filters that negate indexes (non-SARGable).

dev-deliv.officialAlignment: Email Studio > Deliverability > Sender Authentication Package
dev-deliv.title: Level 1-3: Deliverability
dev-deliv.desc: Sender Authentication Package, IP Warmup, and technical domain validation.
dev-deliv.code:
v=spf1 include:cust-spf.exacttarget.com ~all
// Check DMARC and DKIM alignment constantly.
best: Monitor _Bounce Data View asynchronously.
Execute safe volumetric IP Warming.
mistakes: Sending massively without a baseline reputation.
Ignoring repeated hard bounces.

amp-eval.title: Level 2-1: AMPscript Limits
amp-eval.desc: How SFMC processes AMPscript in Subjects and Preheaders vs body, preventing timeouts.
best: Consolidate lookups in Init Blocks.
Treat HTTPGet with caution or asynchronously.
mistakes: Synchronous HTTPGet for each iterator in lists of 10k+.
Expecting the Subject to process variables before initializing them in the Body.

ssjs-api.title: Level 2-2: SSJS Endpoints
ssjs-api.seoTitle: Building Secure JSON APIs with SFMC SSJS
ssjs-api.desc: Create robust native REST Endpoints using Server-Side JavaScript in CloudPages.
best: Validate PII and sanitize inputs.
Wrap in a try/catch block to avoid generic 500s.
mistakes: Forgetting SetResponseHeader causes CORS failures.
Silent failure by not returning error JSON.

telemetry.title: Level 2-3: Built-in Telemetry
telemetry.desc: Implement a framework to track Run Logs, API Attempts, and Errors globally.
best: Mandatory 30-day retention policies.
Obfuscate emails (e.g. te***@domain.com).
mistakes: Unmanageable telemetry Data Extensions due to no auto-deletion.
Logging sensitive PII JSON explicitly.

token-cache.title: Level 3-1: Token Caching
token-cache.seoTitle: SFMC REST API OAuth Token Caching
token-cache.desc: Expiration architecture and secure storage in SSJS to avoid rate limiting.
best: 60s skew buffer.
Lock credentials DE in UI permissions.
mistakes: Requesting token for each REST call (429 Too Many Requests).
Saving exposed secret in plain text templates.

async-api.officialAlignment: Journey Builder > REST API > Fire Event Asynchronously
async-api.title: Level 3-2: Async Injection
async-api.seoTitle: SFMC Bulk REST API & Journey Builder Async Events
async-api.desc: Inject thousands of contacts into JB without busting Rate Limits using an asynchronous and paginated endpoint.
best: Use asynchronous batch over synchronous loops.
Validate destination DEs before triggering the burst.
mistakes: The asynchronous endpoint masks schema failures (returns 202).
Forgetting to configure the input Data Extension correctly.

wsproxy-adv.title: Level 3-3: WSProxy Master
wsproxy-adv.desc: Manipulate deep configurations using WSProxy instead of manual SOAP calls.
best: Parse res.Status and log it.
Validate ObjectTypes with the WSDL.
mistakes: Incorrect property causes 'Property not found'.
Forgetting that 'performItem' requires an exact context.

asset-api.title: Level 4-1: Asset Versioning
asset-api.seoTitle: SFMC Content Builder APIs Asset Versioning
asset-api.desc: Dynamically generate and version assets or manage permissions using CB API.
best: Maintain fixed CustomerKeys for in-place updates.
Sandbox Business Units for CI testing.
mistakes: Calling POST instead of PUT/PATCH generates infinite clones.
Lack of scope limit in integrated packages.

pii-defense.title: Level 4-2: PII Defense Matrix
pii-defense.desc: Techniques to obfuscate PII in operational Data Extensions and maintain compliance.
best: Define automatic 7-day retention in hot DEs.
Use Claim-check pattern in Journeys.
mistakes: Activating FLE (Field Level Encryption) destroys sargability of relational fields.
Sending queries in plain text with PII visible to common users.

tx-api.title: Level 4-3: Transactional Architecture
tx-api.desc: Extreme speed. Transition from Triggered Sends to Transactional Messaging API.
best: Pass personalization in the payload, do not do DB lookups.
Use ENS (Event Notification Service) for failures.
mistakes: Missing attributes causing send failures.
Treating transactional emails as 1M batch campaigns.
